string.text: Water sample from the swamp at the Agroprom Research Institute
Toad wants a water sample from the swamp near the Agroprom Research Institute. He said there's a suitable container for whatever liquid I'll be retrieving. I can find it somewhere in the factory.
Take a water sample from the nearby swamp

Hoplite - a stalker and newcomer from the Cordon - has gotten himself into some trouble. He's been around here for a while, so he might have useful information. To bring him back to his senses, I need to give him either 2 Black Thorn artifacts or 5 regular Thorn artifacts. I think that should do the trick.
Take the artifacts back to Hoplite
